premiumBody: The Spotify account you connect needs Premium so Bagel can control playback and add song requests to your queue. The account that owns your Spotify app needs Premium too, and Spotify lets each app connect at most 5 accounts.
welcomeBody: Let your community pick what plays next. I’ll help you connect Spotify, one little step at a time.
appTitle: A little app. A lot of music.
appBody: Create an app in the Spotify developer dashboard. Paste the Redirect URI below into the app’s Redirect URIs field, then save. It must match exactly, with no extra slash or space.
credentialsBody: In Spotify, open your app’s Settings, then copy the Client ID and the Client Secret into the fields below. Bagel keeps your secret encrypted.
connectBody: Your app is ready. Now connect the Spotify account you play music from, and we’ll bring you back here to set up song requests.
readyBody: Spotify is connected. Next, choose how your viewers request songs: a chat command, channel points, or both.
saved: Your app is saved and ready.
redirectMissing: The Redirect URI is unavailable on our side right now, so you cannot continue yet. Try again later.
